items.title: A finitely presented module flat at a point is free there exactly when its fibre module is free
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a locally finitely presented morphism of algebraic spaces and a finitely presented module flat at a point, the lemma shows the equivalence of four conditions: the fibre module at a geometric point is flat, it is free, the pullback to the fibre is finite free in an etale neighbourhood, and the module itself is finite free in an etale neighbourhood of the original point. The proof works at a geometric point, uses flatness at the point to apply the local freeness criterion over the fibre, and then descends the finite freeness back to an etale neighbourhood of the original point. Passing between the geometric-point statement and the etale-neighbourhood statement is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5959-6000.
